STANDARD_SPEC_BAND.use_for: ordinary bead/material categories where same-material same-spec low/mid/high market price bands are meaningful
STANDARD_SPEC_BAND.rule: low/mid/high are market price bands, not quality grades

SPECIALIST_MATERIAL.use_for: materials where identity, treatment, origin/species, weight, luster, certification or batch uniqueness dominates price
SPECIALIST_MATERIAL.rule: do not force a universal 8mm low/mid/high band before identity/specification is resolved

review_note: 舒俱来 remains provisionally under review: it may use specialist handling for higher-value batches while ordinary round-bead market anchors are still collected.
exclusions: do not classify treated/resin/synthetic goods as the low tier of a natural material
do not merge round-bead and freeform/focal prices
